parameters.name: DesignateType
parameters.description:
The information type of the specified workers that you want to query. Valid values: 1 and 2.

1: the IP address of the specified workers.
2: the tags of the specified workers.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the Applications page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The job ID. You can obtain the ID on the Tasks page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace UID on the Namespaces page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 read-schedulerx-designate-detail --job-id 368 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id test.defalutGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --designate-type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
